landing.title: Impulse26.Key
landing.subtitle: Which Impulse26 Key do you have?
landing.description1: This is an internal test project for Impulse26. Here, a group of engineers are dedicated to designing product experiences for conversational intelligence, service assistants, and team writing scenarios. It's similar to Impulse26, incubated within DesignHub China for distributing new ideas.
landing.description2: We aim to build a toolbox that helps teams improve internal execution, similar to a 'functional key library' for user experience teams. Each test module is seen as a special 'key' representing team members' decision-making methods, work philosophy, and common language.
landing.description3: Note: This is an Impulse26 internal team project, only for internal testing. We encourage you to reflect on your work patterns and apply the results to real collaboration scenarios. Test results will not be stored or used for any formal evaluation.

testIntro.title: How to Play
testIntro.intro1: You will answer a set of workplace scenario questions. There are no standard answers, only different professional approaches. Each choice will push you toward a hidden Impulse Key.
testIntro.intro2: After completion, you will unlock a result. It won't clear your backlog, but it might explain why you suddenly go silent in certain meetings, or suddenly open Figma / Logs / Confluence.
tips: Don't think too long, choose the one that reflects your true reaction.
Don't try to guess the result, the system doesn't necessarily know you better than you know yourself.
Not all Keys will be shown before completion, maintain some sense of exploration.
Results are for internal entertainment only, please do not share on public social media.
testIntro.footer: May your Key be clearer than requirement descriptions.

question.helpText: Don't think too long, intuitive reactions are most accurate. Please choose what's closest to your real thoughts.
